title: feat(app-shell): Studio field panel turns on referenceNameVisible for lookup and user fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb9MCA6uTswj7rQV3aDUowZD)_

Fixes #29629

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: 6590761783

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 对象设计器的字段面板(`ObjectFieldInspector`)在 lookup 与 user 字段上新增「不可读时显示名称」复选框(`referenceNameVisible`)。勾选保存 `true`,取消勾选则把该键从字段定义里删掉;user 字段原本没有类型专属区,现在只为这个开关打开,不显示任何 lookup 选择器配置。字段改成其他类型时该键随之删除,lookup 改成 user 则保留。
- 为什么改:#29171 裁决 B 的键已由服务端下发、控制台渲染(#29460、#29462),但在 Studio 里建对象的管理员看不到也设不了它,只能写代码或走通用元数据表单。
- 风险与回滚:只动字段面板的 lookup / user 两处与类型切换;其他字段类型渲染不变(text、master_detail 无开关有测试钉住)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 的 `changeType`(`dropsNameVisible` 一行)、`nameVisibleToggle` 的 `onCommit`(勾选写 true / 取消走 `unsetDefKey`)、类型专属区的显示条件。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.referenceNameVisible-29629.test.tsx`,预期 11 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The Studio object designer's field panel can now set `FieldSchema.referenceNameVisible` (director ruling 6574398310, letter B), which until now only the generic `field` metadata form and code could reach.

| Field in the panel | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `lookup` | picker config, then the related-list section; no control for the key | a "Show Name When Unreadable" checkbox after the picker config, its help text as the input's accessible description |
| `user` | no type-specific section at all | a "User options" section holding that checkbox alone; no reference picker, display field, filters, dependent fields or related list (the target is always `sys_user`) |
| `master_detail`, `tree`, `text` and every other type | unchanged | unchanged, no checkbox (the spec refuses the key there) |

- **Checked** saves `referenceNameVisible: true` through the inspector's `patchDef`. **Cleared** removes the key through `unsetDefKey`, so the field carries no `referenceNameVisible` at all rather than `false` or an own `undefined` key. A stored `false` (which the spec accepts on these two types) reads unchecked.
- **Retype.** `changeType` stripped only `picklist` and option kinds before. It now also removes `referenceNameVisible` when the next type is neither `lookup` nor `user`, since `FieldSchema` refuses the key there, `false` included. `lookup` to `user` keeps it.
- **Wording.** The inspector localises through `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio namespace, so the label and help text are two new keys there, `designer.field.lookup.referenceNameVisible` and `designer.field.lookup.referenceNameVisible.help`. The `en` text is the `field.form.ts` row from #29462 word for word; the `zh` text is that branch's zh-CN translation, so both authoring surfaces describe the key in one wording.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.referenceNameVisible-29629.test.tsx` (new, 11). Every write case ends at the saved field's own keys and at `FieldSchema`:

- `lookup` and `user` offer the checkbox; checking it saves `referenceNameVisible: true` and `FieldSchema` accepts the field.
- The help text is the checkbox's accessible description.
- Clearing removes the key (`hasOwnProperty` false); a stored `false` reads unchecked and checking it writes `true`.
- CONTROL: a `text` and a `master_detail` field offer no checkbox.
- CONTROL: a `user` field shows none of the lookup controls (related object, picker config, display field, selectable records, depends on, related list).
- A retype from `lookup` to Text removes the key (no `FieldSchema` issue at that path); a retype to User keeps it.
- zh: the checkbox is labelled from the studio catalogue.

Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty, each red:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| A1 `offersReferenceNameVisible` returns `false` (the `user` path) | 3 failed |
| A2 the retype's `delete nextDef.referenceNameVisible` removed | 1 failed |
| A3 clearing writes `patchDef` with an `undefined` value instead of `unsetDefKey` | 1 failed |
| A4 the lookup render guard set to `false` | 5 failed |

## Acceptance notes

- Surface: exactly the claim's files. `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` (the lookup section, the `user` section predicate, `changeType`), the new test beside it, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts` (two keys each), and `.changeset/29629-studio-reference-name-visible.md` (patches for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`). The studio namespace table is a plain string-to-string record outside the locale packs, so the new keys widen no published type; the claim's `Clause-②: no` holds.
- The checkbox is drawn in this file rather than with `_shared.tsx`'s `InspectorCheckboxField`, which takes no description; that helper is outside the surface.
- In display-patch mode (a base object's field) the checkbox is locked and wrapped like its neighbours (`DisplayPatchLock`); `referenceNameVisible` is not on the base-field display whitelist.
- Studio at phone width was not measured: the designer's canvas row did not take a click at 390 px in the probe, which is the designer's own layout and not this control's.

## Verification

Real backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` in `examples/app-crm`) and the source Console on Vite, as the admin, on head `6ae9d0e1` (this PR's code is unchanged by the later main merge). Screenshots and scripts are in the project folder `issue-29629/` (`shots/`, `setup.mjs`, `measure.cjs`, `shot.cjs`), not on GitHub.

<details><summary>Toggle, publish, reload: the definition carries the key; clearing removes it</summary>

- A scratch package `com.example.rnv` over REST: `rnv_payroll`, and `rnv_expense` with `payroll` (lookup to `rnv_payroll`) and `reviewer` (user), neither declaring the key.
- Before (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` from `origin/main` on the same server): selecting `payroll` shows the picker config and the related list with no such control; selecting `reviewer` shows no type section at all (`before-desktop-payroll.png`, `before-desktop-reviewer.png`).
- After, at `/apps/setup/metadata/object/rnv_expense`: the checkbox is on both fields. Checking it on both autosaved the draft (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/rnv_expense?mode=draft` 200), Publish answered `POST …/rnv_expense/publish` 200, and `GET /api/v1/meta/object/rnv_expense` then served `payroll` as `{ name, type: lookup, label, reference: rnv_payroll, referenceNameVisible: true }` and `reviewer` as `{ name, type: user, label, referenceNameVisible: true }`. After a reload both checkboxes read checked (`after-desktop-payroll.png`, `after-desktop-reviewer.png`).
- Clearing `reviewer`'s checkbox and publishing again served `reviewer` as `{ name, type: user, label }`, the key absent, while `payroll` kept `true`.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates and suites</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate (default tier). Changed lines 294 before the merge.
- On the merged head `cb1d7f87` (main `b391feb1` merged, 9 commits, none touching these files): `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` exit 0 (both executed, cache miss); 150 test files that import `ObjectFieldInspector` or the studio namespace, in three locked batches at 2 workers: 49/49, 47/47, 54/54 files (357, 767, 680 tests).
- On the merged head `cb1d7f87`: the derived `dispatch-gates --commands` set, 35 commands, every one exit 0, including `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the verify lock (170 files passed, 2 skipped); `--ran` reconciles 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Before the merge the same set (36 then, with `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`) was also all exit 0.
- Before the merge: `eslint` on the four touched source files exit 0 (warnings only, all on lines this PR does not touch); ui `check:phantom-deps`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:metadata-write-doors` exit 0.
- The repo-wide sweep (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm) is CI's.

</details>
